name: spd-on-mwg
description: Shattered Pixel Dungeon, ported onto the mwg framework. GPL-3.0-or-later, same as the game it ports.

scripts.build: npm run mwl:compile && tsc --noEmit && vite build && node tools/emit.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run test:simulation && npm run test:items && npm run test:lua && npm run test:mwg && npm run build
scripts.check: npm run mwl:compile && tsc --noEmit && npm run i18n:verify
scripts.test:simulation: node tools/verifySimulation.mjs && node tools/verifyBanner.mjs && node tools/verifyVault.mjs
